### About this repository

This is where Legesher's research into multilingual programming lives, starting with [Expedition Tiny Aya](https://github.com/legesher/research/tree/main/expedition-tiny-aya): what happens when a multilingual model is fine-tuned on code written in other languages. The datasets, adapters and results are published on [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/legesher); this repository holds the code that produced them.

If you've spotted a number that doesn't add up, a step that won't reproduce, or a question the research should ask, this is the right place.
